# Git workflow

- Write commit messages as Conventional Commits: `type(scope): description`, with types such as feat, fix, docs, test and chore. Mark a breaking change with `!` before the colon or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer. Why: Typed messages make the history easy to scan and let tools derive changelogs and versions.
